system.what: Ghosts of a village the sea took
system.plan: One more voice for the choir
system.weakness: A bell from the drowned church, rung at low tide
system.hiddenPlace: The drowned village in Saltmarsh at low tide
system.signature: Lure: one attack; then the standing character with the lowest Heart rolls Heart against Danger (no Power fits, it isn't casting, and no Hurt on a Partial or a Failure); on a Failure they lose their next action (a second Lure the same round takes next round's).
